sample_sparse_coords_norm: sample sparse normalized coordinates from Gaussian covariance maps using random uniform or greedy conditional entropy mode
get_domain: extract valid coordinate vectors and 2x2 Gaussian covariance matrices from a batched covariance tensor with optional masking
random_uniform: uniformly sample n coordinates without replacement from a batched domain of normalized coordinate tensors
batch_var: compute predictive variance for test coordinates given training coordinates using GP covariance and Cholesky decomposition
greedy_conditional_entropy: greedily sample coordinates by maximizing conditional entropy using incremental Cholesky updates and covariance backends
